name: Rewarx Studio AI
summary: AI product photography for Shopify and e-commerce sellers: turns one product photo into studio shots, model photos, ghost-mannequin images, mockups and listing sets, on monthly credits.
best_for: Shopify sellers in fashion, beauty, jewellery and home goods who need many consistent product, model and lifestyle images from one product photo and would otherwise pay for a shoot
skip_if: you want a vendor with a public track record and published refund terms, or most of your output must be video or 4K, where the credits run out quickly
honest_knock: It is a young app: the Shopify listing shows a launch date of 11 May 2026 and no reviews yet, so there is no public track record. Credits go fast once you use 4K or video: 100 credits buy about 100 standard photos but only about 33 4K photos or 5 videos. The listing states no refund terms, no rollover of unused credits and no price for extra credits, and Rewarx may bill some charges outside your Shopify invoice.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month on the Shopify App Store listing, billed in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on the Rewarx listing in the Shopify App Store; the listing says all charges are billed in USD) Rewarx's own pricing page shows no amounts, so the Shopify listing is the public price list. Free gives 10 AI product photo credits. Starter is $29.90 a month or $299 a year for 100 credits a month, Growth $54.90 a month or $549 a year for 200 credits, and Scale $129.90 a month or $1,299 a year for 500 credits; the annual price saves 17%. Credits are one pool for photos and video: the listing translates 100 credits into roughly 100 standard photos, or about 33 photos in 4K Ultra, or 5 cinematic videos. Starter removes the watermark; Scale adds batch templates and a dedicated support manager. The listing warns that external charges may be billed by Rewarx Limited separately from your Shopify invoice, and does not say whether unused credits roll over or what extra credits cost.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Rewarx AI Product Photography (Rewarx Studio AI in the dossier) on a Shopify development store: the install, one AI photo of a snowboard made with 1 of 10 free credits, the watermark, the offer popup, the Membership Plans, the external Stripe checkout that was opened but not filled in, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid. Install: the App Store listing is Rewarx AI Product Photography by Rewarx Limited. The install form was sent at about 13:32 in our own tab and the Install app dialog asked for View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Products, Shopify admin), which was approved. The first screen said Session Expired and Click below to reconnect; the button Reconnect via Shopify worked in the same tab and the app loaded. No separate account, phone number or demo was asked. A welcome popup, Welcome to the Studio!, credited 10 free production credits and said we were eligible for 67% OFF the first membership purchase. Core action, an AI product photo of a shop product: Studio, Photography Studio, From Shopify (Import from Shopify Store), the product The Collection Snowboard: Liquid, Use Selected Image, Generate Photos (1 Credits), Confirm Products (Snowboard Top Deck, Confirm Selection (1)) and the question Add a model for better results? answered with No, Keep Simple, so no faces. That was 9 clicks and the result was visible at about 13:35, about 3 to 4 minutes after the install was confirmed. The Library shows the source photo and one result; the viewer shows Photography Studio, Asset Type Photo and Variations 2 / 2. The snowboards stand against a wooden fence in snow with mountains behind them, and the liquid lettering and the graphic stayed recognisable. The photo carries a watermark, rewarx.com, and a banner says Unlock commercial rights & remove watermarks, Upgrade to Pro. The credit counter went from 10 to 9. A file upload runs through a file dialog that we could not reach, so the import from the Shopify store was used. Offer after the first result: a popup First Studio Shot Achievement! showed a one-time Starter Plan offer at EUR 9.90/mo (EUR 29.90 crossed out) with a countdown OFFER ENDS IN 59:20 and the button Claim Discount Now. The popup did not close with the X, Escape or a click beside it; after a reload it was gone and a purple bar STARTER PLAN OFFER: ONLY EUR 9.90 FIRST MONTH stayed. Plans: Upgrade opens Membership Plans in euro with a switch Monthly or Yearly (SAVE 17%): Starter EUR 9.90/mo (EUR 29.90 crossed out, FIRST MONTH DISCOUNT, 100 Credits, No Watermark, Commercial Poster Studio, E-commerce Listing Asset Sets, about 100 Standard Photos or about 33 4K Ultra Photos or 5 Cinematic Videos), Growth EUR 54.90/mo (Save 8%, 200 credits), Scale EUR 129.90/mo (Save 13%, 500 credits, Batch Template Studio, a dedicated manager) and Agency EUR 249.90/mo (Save 16%, 1000 credits, unlimited cloud storage, API access, multi-user access, priority GPU queue, white-label portal, custom style training). The listing names no Agency plan and prices in USD; the amounts for Growth and Scale are numerically the same. Checkout: a click on Subscribe for Starter did NOT open a Shopify Approve subscription screen but an external live Stripe checkout in Dutch (our browser language): Abonneren op Starter EUR 9,37, then EUR 28,29 per month from next month, Starter EUR 28,29, a coupon of EUR -18,92 (66,89% korting voor een maand), Totaal vandaag te betalen EUR 9,37, a choice between EUR and USD (1 USD = 0,9462 EUR), fields for Apple Pay, Link, an e-mail address and a card number and the button Betalen en abonneren. It asks for a card and is not a Shopify test charge, so nothing was entered or paid. The billing therefore runs outside Shopify, in line with the dossier warning that external charges may be billed by Rewarx Limited separately from the Shopify invoice. Cancelling: no subscription was started, so there was nothing to cancel. The uninstall route is Settings, Apps, the menu and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall Rewarx AI Product Photography? says you will no longer be able to use the app and that data managed by the app will be deleted, with a required reason (Testing multiple apps) and a feedback field. The app was uninstalled after the test and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: paying, any plan beyond reading the prices, 4K or 2K upscaling, video, poster, ghost mannequin, model and try-on functions, uploading an own file, downloading, cancelling a paid plan, a refund and credit rollover. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no subscription and no payment were made; 1 of the 10 free credits was used; no theme change was saved. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app first showed Session Expired and needed a reconnect, the offer popup after the first photo could not be closed and carries a countdown, the free photo has a watermark, billing runs through an external Stripe checkout in a live mode that asks for a card instead of a Shopify approval screen, the app shows a fourth plan Agency and prices in euro, and a file upload could not be reached for our tooling.
